idea: Motivation follows action, so the two minute start is the whole mechanism
empoweringBelief: הפעולה היא זאת שמייצרת את המוטיבציה
title: למה המוטיבציה אף פעם לא מגיעה
caption:
כולם מחכים להרגיש מוכנים. זה הרגע שאף פעם לא מגיע. המוטיבציה נולדת אחרי שמתחילים, לא לפני, ושתי דקות מספיקות כדי להדליק אותה 🔥

מה הדבר הקטן שאתם דוחים כבר חודשים?

hook.en: You have been waiting for motivation for three whole years.

value.en: And it still has not shown up.
Because motivation never arrives before the work does.
It shows up only after you have already begun.
The brain starts moving first and then it wants more.
So the whole secret is to start ridiculously small.
Two minutes only, and not one minute more.
Open the notebook and write one single line.
Put the shoes on and walk to the end of one street.
That sounds far too small to matter, right?
That is exactly the reason it actually works.
The brain does not fight something this small.
There is nothing here for it to be afraid of.
And after those two minutes something happens.
You simply do not feel like stopping.
That is momentum, and momentum is the whole story.
Do this for seven days in a row.

value.he: סמנו איקס על היומן כל ערב
value.en: Mark a cross on the calendar every single evening.
That chain becomes stronger than any motivation ever was.

fear.he: עכשיו תדמיינו את עצמכם בעוד שנה
fear.en: Now picture yourself exactly one year from today.

fear.he: אותה מיטה, אותה שעה, אותה תחושה
fear.en: The same bed, the same hour, the same feeling.
The same list you never touched even once.

fear.he: וזה יקרה אם לא תתחילו היום
fear.en: And that will happen if you do not start today.
